# semaphore_ex_template_acl (Data Source)

Reads a Semaphore EX template ACL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_template_acl" "operator" {
  project_id  = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  template_id = semaphore_ex_project_template.example.id
  id          = semaphore_ex_template_acl.operator.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)
- `template_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `allowed_permissions` (Set of String)
- `denied_permissions` (Set of String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)
- `role_id` (String)
- `role_slug` (String)
